notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-1.99.3.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Thay muc "He ket cau" bang cau hinh tung tang (1 tang: chi Mai + Tang 1): Mai: Cot khung keo / Khung keo (Thep / BTCT / BTCT DUL) + Mai/San mai (Tole / Deck-Bondeck / BTCT / BTCT DUL / Tuy chon). Tang n: Cot / Dam (Thep / BTCT / BTCT DUL) + San (Deck-Bondeck / BTCT / BTCT DUL / Tuy chon). Tang 1: Cot (Thep / BTCT / BTCT DUL) + Nen (Be tong / BTCT / Tuy chon). Moi tang co o "Mep cot - truc" (trong = tu dong). Nut dat nhanh: Toan thep / Khung BTCT + mai tole / Toan BTCT.
